### Trop Casino Greenville Celebrates 30 Years of Entertainment, Hospitality and Community Impact


11/05/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) DOCX](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/2026/Nov/05/PRESS-RELEASE_Trop-Casino-Greenville-30th-Anniversary.docx)


**GREENVILLE, Miss. (Nov. 5, 2026)** – Trop Casino Greenville proudly celebrates its 30th Anniversary this month, marking three decades of gaming excitement, exceptional guest service and meaningful contributions to the Mississippi Delta community.


Since opening its doors in 1996, Trop Casino Greenville has welcomed thousands of guests, created employment opportunities and become a premier entertainment destination in the region. As the property celebrates this historic milestone, guests are invited to join in a month-long anniversary celebration featuring giveaways, promotions, tournaments and exciting cash drawings.


"30 years is an incredible achievement and a testament to the loyalty of our guests, the dedication of our Team Members and the support of the Greenville community," said Gerald Beasley, General Manager of Trop Casino Greenville. "We are proud of our history and excited to celebrate this milestone with the guests who have made it all possible."


**Throughout November, guests can participate in a variety of anniversary promotions, including:**


- **Tuesday Hot Seats:** From 2 p.m. to 5 p.m. every Tuesday in November, guests will have the chance to be selected during Hot Seat drawings to win $250 in Free Slot Play.


- **Wednesday Anniversary T-Shirt Giveaway:** From 4 p.m. to 7 p.m. every Wednesday in November, guests can receive a commemorative 30th Anniversary T-shirt while supplies last.


- **Thursday Slot Tournaments:** Starting at 5 p.m. on Thursdays, guests can put their skills to the test for a chance to win up to $1,000 in Free Slot Play.


- **Friday Scratch-Offs:** A long-time guest favorite returns every Friday in November with exciting scratch-off prizes and instant-winning opportunities.


- **$300,000 Cash Drawing:** On select Saturdays in November, guests will have the opportunity to participate in the property's exciting $300,000 Cash Drawings. Qualifier drawings will be held on, Nov. 14 and 21, while the Grand Finale will take place on Nov. 28.


Guests are encouraged to visit[https://www.caesars.com/tropicana-greenville/casino/promotions](https://www.caesars.com/tropicana-greenville/casino/promotions) or stop by the Caesars Rewards® Center for complete promotion details, rules and eligibility requirements.


###


## **About Trop Casino Greenville**


Trop Casino Greenville is a leading gaming and entertainment destination in Greenville, Mississippi, offering casino gaming, dining, promotions, and exceptional guest service. For 30 years, the property has remained committed to delivering memorable guest experiences while supporting the communities it serves.
